# Tricky Words: Word Search Puzzle

> A relaxing Android word-search puzzle with handcrafted levels, daily challenges, word and phrase discovery, helpful letter hints, achievements and offline gameplay.

## Canonical links
- Website: https://vcqapp-hub.github.io/tricky-words/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.vcqapp.trickywords
- Package ID: com.vcqapp.trickywords
- Publisher: VCQ
- Category: Game / Word Puzzle

## Core capabilities
- Handcrafted word-search levels.
- Daily calendar challenges and streaks.
- Hidden-word discovery across letter grids.
- Meanings for words, idioms and phrases.
- Hint coins that reveal a next-letter coordinate.
- Progress, achievements, rewards and league trophies.
- Offline campaign, challenge and dictionary content.
